mapper.insert: INSERT INTO market_kline (symbol, timeframe, open_time, open, high, low, close, ticks) VALUES (#{symbol}, #{tf.code}, #{time}, #{open}, #{high}, #{low}, #{close}, #{ticks}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE high = VALUES(high), low = VALUES(low), close = VALUES(close), ticks = VALUES(ticks)
mapper.select: SELECT symbol, timeframe, open_time, open, high, low, close, ticks FROM market_kline WHERE symbol = #{symbol} AND timeframe = #{tf} ORDER BY open_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
